renderer: CYBR SCENES R2 / Hot Springs: stochastic sinter/mineral surfaces and sky MIS
spectral_method: Jointly transported fixed midpoint wavelength quadrature, 25 nm bins
steam_model: Authored heterogeneous trilinear density grid; grid-bounded delta and ratio tracking; HG phase
sky_model: Single-scattering spherical Rayleigh/aerosol spectral LUT, not reference-validated
material_spectra: Reference-illuminant-calibrated RGB-anchor reflectance, not measured mineral spectra
cloud_model: Bounded 3D extinction grid; conservative column-majorant DDA; delta-tracked scattering and ratio-tracked shadows
water_reflection_estimator: Primary: GGX VNDF and solar-disc MIS; indirect: one-root macro reflection manifold with exclusive path ownership
underwater_direct_light_approximation: One-root macro-surface manifolds approximate indirect reflected and transmitted caustics; primary reflection uses GGX
